notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm just writing a quick announcement to let you know I've uploaded a new build of the game. This build should fix a technical issue which prevented the music from being played properly during the opening scenes of the VN.

I've also fixed a couple of typos which were found in the English script, and I fixed a bug which prevented players from swapping back to the Spanish language option in the preferences screen after initially selecting a language.

As always, thank you to everybody for pointing these issues out. It's appreciated! If you find more issues in the game, do let me know, and I will try to fix everything in a timely manner.

- ebi x

notes.title: Spanish translation
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I’m just writing a quick update to let all of you know that The Mermaid of Zennor has been fully translated into Spanish by Aarón Acencio! I’m very thankful for his hard work, and I’m looking forward to being able to introduce Mermaid to a wider audience!

I hope that you all enjoy the story, and that you find it a worthwhile experience.

As always, please feel free to let me know if you find any typos, grammatical issues, or any other misc bugs in this new build, and I’ll try to fix everything when I’m able.

Thank you!

- ebi x

notes.title: Russian translation added
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I’m just writing an update to let everybody know that I’ve uploaded a new build of The Mermaid of Zennor. This new build corrects a couple of typos present in the English script of the VN and, more importantly, adds a full Russian translation by Mikhail "KornyPony" Burov-Kosolapin. As always, he’s done a fantastic job, and his efforts are very much appreciated!

Please let me know if this update breaks anything in the game, or if you find more typos. I’ll do my best to fix everything!

I hope you enjoy your time with Mermaid, too, if you’re going to read it for the first time!

- ebi x
